interpretation: Sequential re-centering is not a prerequisite for the observed mean and seed-mean collapse outcomes on this grid.
The interval crosses zero and no equivalence margin was specified, so neither superiority nor equivalence is established.
Actor count, optimizer work, anchoring, and realized critic trajectories differ; this is not a re-centering-only causal ablation or a reproduction of published MCEP.
